description: Shared WP2 PDF tile render fixture (plans/WP2-render-shared_contract.md). Georefs come from pdf_georef.json; every expected number is computed by scripts/gen_pdf_tile_render.py with a PROJ pipeline + plain python geometry, never from app code. Regenerate, dont hand edit.

conventions.pageSpace: WP1 raw user space: y up, box origins included, /Rotate ignored
conventions.georef: toWGS84/toPage exactly as pdf_georef.json conventions; georefs looked up by sheet id in pdf_georef.json sheets[].expected (crs, datum, affine, crop)
conventions.pageBox: CropBox intersect MediaBox (MediaBox when there is no CropBox)
conventions.clipPolygon: Sutherland-Hodgman of the crop (as written, in order) against pageBox, clip edges in order x >= x0, x <= x1, y >= y0, y <= y1. a point on a clip edge is inside; an intersection is emitted only when S and E are on opposite sides. then drop a vertex equal (|dx|,|dy| <= 1e-9) to the previous one, wrap included. clipMean is the plain mean of these vertices, so duplicates change it; compare the polygon as a cyclic sequence (same orientation, any start)
conventions.footprint: clip polygon densified to 32 segments per edge (vertex k of edge i = P_i + (P_i+1 - P_i) * k/32, k = 0..31), each through toWGS84 then spherical web mercator z0 world units: X = (lon + 180) / 360 * 256, Y = (1 - ln(tan(pi/4 + lat/2)) / pi) / 2 * 256, y down
conventions.tileClassification: tile (z,x,y) square = [x, x+1] x [y, y+1] * 256 / 2^z in z0 units, closed. EDGE when the footprint boundary touches the square, INSIDE when it doesnt and the square centre is inside the footprint, otherwise OUTSIDE
conventions.tileLists: sorted by y then x, entries [x, y]. sha256 = hex sha256 of the ascii lines 'z/x/y' joined by \n (no trailing newline) in that order. runs = [y, xFirst, xLast] row major
conventions.jobPixels: job pixel (u, v), y down, origin top-left of tile (x0, y0): wx = x0*256 + u*256/tilePx, wy = y0*256 + v*256/tilePx at zoom z, lon = wx / (256*2^z) * 360 - 180, lat = atan(sinh(pi * (1 - 2*wy / (256*2^z)))), then georef.toPage
conventions.warp: rects are [l, t, r, b] in job px, r and b exclusive. pageToPx [a,b,c,d,e,f]: u = a*x + b*y + c, v = d*x + e*y + f. root = job rect intersect (floor(min u) - 2, floor(min v) - 2, ceil(max u) + 2, ceil(max v) + 2) of the footprint in job px; null when empty. cells listed in depth first order, children TL, TR, BL, BR. cellCount counts emitted (non OUTSIDE) leaves; leafCount includes OUTSIDE leaves; droppedCells = non-finite/singular leaves at the split limit. cell coverage is the page quad TL, TR, BR, BL against the clip polygon
conventions.zoom: tileZoom = clamp(round(cameraZoom), minZoom, maxZoom), round = ties up (camera zoom is > 0). pinch: clamp(zoom + log2(scale), 2, 22)

tolerances.pxPerPtRelNote: 1e-9 holds when pxPerPt is computed from the fixture mercMetresPerPoint; from a platform's own value use 1e-6
tolerances.stagedNote: stagedRegion pad/region/rw/rh 1e-9 pt (abs), cap/d0/d 1e-12 rel; W, H, maxPx, shrinkSteps, result exact
tolerances.exact: W, H, mips, detailZoom, baseMaxZoom, tile sets, counts, rects, job formation, draw plans, crash guard, tilePx

margins.note: the generator refuses to write if any discrete decision is closer than these, so a correct platform implementation can't legitimately land on the other side

tilePx.formula: round(256 * min(density, 3) / 16) * 16, ties round up (half away from zero)

tileCache.unit: bytes, MB in the contract means MiB

warpSyntheticGeorefs.note: not a PDF. build the georef straight from these numbers (crs, datum, affine, crop) and use mediaBox as the page box

jobFormation.label: heavy, everything pending: right, down, left then stop at 6
heavy, only a strip to the right: second pass takes the 3rd column
heavy, column strip down: rows grow to 3
heavy, right blocked so it grows down/left/up into 2x3
heavy, a hole in the row below stops down for good
heavy, fallback band and other zooms dont count
heavy, east world edge, no wrap

drawPlan.label: centre missing, parent loaded, base ancestor at fz 12 requested first
fz ancestor already loaded is not requested again
6 levels up is past the 4 level search, loaded children fill in
same but fz 9 makes the search 6 deep so the ancestor wins
mixed: EMPTY own, EMPTY parent stops the search, coarse ancestor drawn first
nothing cached, fz shared by all four is requested once
antimeridian: wrapped x uses its own ancestor quadrant

crashGuard.label: import ok, then a clean launch
first vector render crashes, Not Now keeps the suspect, Open Anyway clears it
background never arms, entering background disarms without verifying
crash in a render of another map does not suspect the restored one
bake always arms, a bake crash is reported and nothing is suppressed
a finished bake clears its marker and verifies nothing
base/vector arm next to an in-flight bake marker and never touch it
import replaces a base/vector marker, complete only clears its own marker
table order: an interrupted import wins over a standing suspect
LRU: 16 tokens max, verifying touches, oldest goes first
import during a bake: the bake marker survives, a later crash still says bakeInterrupted
crash in an import probe while a bake runs: both notices
crash in a first vector render during a bake: suppress and bakeInterrupted
complete(bake) only clears its own token, a second bake arm replaces the slot
a standing suspect is still suppressed when the bake was interrupted too
base/vector still never replace an in-flight import marker
legacy file: a bake marker in inProgress reads as an interrupted bake

bakeJobFormation.label: raster sampled levels stay 1x1 even when heavy
heavy above baseMaxZoom: aligned 3x2 blocks in first encounter order
heavy is read once per level, a flip mid level waits for the next level
ragged level: only intersecting tiles are wanted, a block can hold just one
world edge: blocks are clamped, baseMaxZoom 0
no base raster (baseMaxZoom null): every level is vector

failureAccounting.label: three render errors in a row go sticky as renderError
a successful job resets the run
the 3rd failure names the reason: outOfMemory
outOfMemory earlier in the run doesnt win, the 3rd does
an unknown error counts as renderError
raster sample and base raster failures count, a raster sample success resets
passwordProtected from a job is sticky at once
pageMissing from a job is sticky at once
pageGeometry from a job is sticky at once
document level failures are sticky at once
the blank verdict is sticky at once, even mid run
cancelled jobs and bake/estimate jobs neither count nor reset
sticky ignores everything until Try Again, which starts clean
R1: a successful base raster resets the run
R2: started jobs abandoned by every waiter still count
R2: an abandoned job that succeeds still resets the run and feeds the EWMA
R2: a job cancelled before it started has no effect on the run or the EWMA
R1: started once, a failure counts once, re-attempted only for z <= baseMaxZoom
R1: three failed base attempts in a row go sticky, then nothing starts
R1: base failures and job failures share the one run
R1: a blank base raster is sticky blank, nothing re-starts
R1: a document-level failure from the base raster is sticky at once

stagedRegion.label: pad 2/required grows the cell bbox, oversample wins
pad is cut back to the clip bbox on every side
cell bbox hanging past the clip bbox is cut to it
cap wins and the ceil pushes W x H over, one 0.99 step
cap wins on a heavy block
thin region, the max(1, ceil) side forces several 0.99 steps
tiny job, big required: cap wins
R5: cell bbox entirely outside the clip bbox
R5: padded bbox only touches the clip bbox edge, zero width
marks outside the clip polygon but inside its bbox never count toward non-blank
stagedRegion.note: white paper over the MediaBox plus four black squares in the BBox corners, all outside the /Bounds quad. the base raster is clipped to the quad before paper fill + draw (G3), so every covered stride sample stays alpha 0 and the import fails with blank. if the marks counted it wouldnt

cases.label: heavy sheet, three samples, room for everything
light: EWMA at exactly 60 ms is not heavy
raster sampled default: no EWMA, jobMs is the sample mean
one sample EMPTY, one failed: means over the one that delivered
no samples at all: every number falls back
no samples but a live EWMA: jobMs from the EWMA, the rest falls back
free space fits only D-2: it becomes the initial selection
no option fits: all disabled, the default stays selected, Generate disabled
free space unknown: every option is enabled

rules.tiles: locale grouped integer, no decimals (en 1,646 / de 1.646)
rules.size: tenthsMB = floor((bytes + 50000) / 100000), at least 1 when bytes > 0. tenthsMB < 1000 -> '<tenthsMB / 10 grouped><decimal><tenthsMB % 10> MB'. else wholeMB = floor((bytes + 500000) / 1000000); wholeMB < 1000 -> '<wholeMB grouped> MB'. else tenthsGB = floor((bytes + 50000000) / 100000000) -> '<tenthsGB / 10 grouped><decimal><tenthsGB % 10> GB'. integer math, one U+0020 space before the unit, units MB/GB in every locale

psnr.definition: RGB, 8 bit, peak 255, over the pixels with alpha 255 in the live tile; MSE 0 counts as 99.0 dB; the gate is the minimum over every tile checked
psnr.zoomRule: for each tilePx: z = baseMaxZoom..detailZoom (normal budget), one tile per z = the middle INSIDE tile in row-major order, inside[floor(n / 2)]; a z with no INSIDE tile is skipped. at least one vector zoom (z > baseMaxZoom) must be checked

georef.note: what a WP1 parse of the /VP gives (least squares over the written GPTS/LPTS); compare like pdf_georef.json sheets (0.01 m, 1e-3 pt)

clippedMarker.label: outside crop box
clippedMarker.note: inside the neatline but outside the CropBox: must NOT be drawn (alpha 0)

hiddenOcgSquare.note: in optional content group oc1, OFF in the default config. paper white expected

blank.note: white page plus a 254/255 grey box. every base raster sample is either transparent or has min(R,G,B) > 250, so the import fails with blank

linework.note: white paper over the MediaBox, then diagonal i = 0..40 from (x0 + w*i/40 - w/2, y0) to (x0 + w*i/40 + w/2, y1), then vertical and horizontal grid lines every 12 pt from the MediaBox origin. stroked with butt caps
